pictures.name: SW1-Puri-Shore
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. Evening on the sea shore at Puri, eastern India, centuries ago. Two travelers walk barefoot along wet sand toward a distant tall stone temple spire glowing in the last sun. Guru Nanak is seen only from behind, his face never visible: a tall figure in a long faded saffron-brown robe, a simple wrapped turban, a cloth bag on his shoulder. Beside him walks Mardana, a lean dark-bearded Muslim musician in a plain white kurta and small cap, carrying a rabab (a wooden stringed lute), seen in three-quarter view. Long shadows, gentle surf, deep blue sea, gold sky.

pictures.name: SW4-Sky-Tray
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. A vast night sky over the sea at Puri, painted like a great round golden offering tray: a full moon and a low setting sun glowing like two lamps, countless stars scattered like pearls, palm trees and forest at the edge like a garland of flowers, a soft breeze moving the leaves like drifting incense. A tiny far figure in a saffron-brown robe stands on the shore, seen from behind, looking up. Awe and wonder.
